component.name: Seedforger
component.summary: Report upload/download stats to a BitTorrent tracker without transferring bytes

description.p: A modern .NET revival of RatioMaster built around believability: client impersonation, swarm-aware speeds, stealth timing, a real peer-wire engine and goal-seeking campaigns. Shipped with a reproducible research annex showing why the client side cannot win. Educational / security-research tool.
